item.title: The Daemon Talking to a Room That Couldn't Hear It
item.description: The scariest bug in a multi-agent system isn’t a crash. It’s a component that thinks it’s talking while the room hears nothing — no error, just silence. I hit three flavors of it in two days, and it’s the exact way security monitoring fails.
